messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "keep the bottle tightly closed when not in use"
set: ["keep the bottle tightly closed when not in use", "keep the cap on when not in use", "keep oral solution in a tightly closed light-resistant bottle with a child-resistant cap", "store the oral liquid at room temperature and keep it in a tightly closed bottle", "keep in a closed container", "keep pen cap on when not in use", "keep tablets and capsules in a tightly closed light-resistant container with a child-resistant cap", "use the dropper supplied with the bottle", "shake the bottle before each use", "store in original bottle", "store tightly closed at room temperature away from moisture, heat, and light", "keep in foil pouch until ready to use", "do not keep leftover", "use within 8 weeks of opening bottle", "use within 90 days of opening bottle", "store tablets at room temperature between 68°F and 77°F (20°C to 25°C) in original closed bottle"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
